answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 12929 Country: India Title: Dear Mufti sahab, As salaam wailaikum. Is it allow in Islam to work as a life insurance agent, against which someone should get commissioned. Question: Dear Mufti sahab, As salaam wailaikum. Is it allow in Islam to work as a life insurance agent, against which someone should get commissioned. Answer ID: 12929 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 762/571=L/1430) Life insurance contains interest as well as gambling and both these things are unlawful by Quran and Hadith. Therefore, working as agent of life insurance is helping in sin, so it is prohibited by Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
